\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{pgfplots}
\usetikzlibrary{arrows.meta}
\pgfplotsset{compat=1.18,
 quiver/after arrow/.code={\typeout{QUIVER-META: raw=\pgfplotspointmeta; transformed=\pgfplotspointmetatransformed}}}
\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
\begin{axis}[view={0}{90},domain=0:3,y domain=0:0,samples=4,
 xmin=-1,xmax=5,ymin=-1,ymax=1,zmin=-1,zmax=1,
 point meta rel=per plot]
 \addplot3[point meta=x,point meta min=0,point meta max=4,
 quiver={u=.6,v=0,every arrow/.style={-{Latex}}}] {0};
 \addplot3[point meta=2,
 quiver={u=.6,v=0,every arrow/.style={-{Latex}}}] {0};
 \addplot3[quiver={u=.6,v=0,every arrow/.style={-{Latex}}}] {0};
\end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
